subject: general
question:
In the figure given below the triangle represents balls, the circle represents chairs and the rectangle represents wickets. The number in each area represents the number of items in that area.

Which of the following statement is correct?

I. Number of wickets which are only chairs are 10.

II. Total number of balls are 14 less than the total number of wickets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a79769313aabcd03d86d752fde79651ac416bb6dfcdf09528d37c8910109d4b.png]
solution: **Given: ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86ba12b3303d5dcfddf8bd17d4abf8e1bcaf8b83a964217c876931f75a0f40b9.png] I. Number of wickets which are only chairs are 10. - True [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/849037d10f7927ee39d2d0c1ec873abefe2c9d1792f5b74df46ec28cb318db42.png] II. Total number of balls are 14 less than the total number of wickets. - False
